crossRefs.note: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain…

but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me
We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we…

where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: We sought out the disciples in Tyre and stayed with them seven days. Through the Spirit they kept telling Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
translations.asv: And having found the disciples, we tarried there seven days: and these said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not set foot in Jerusalem.
